title: Vendor and RFP evaluation matrix
description: Independently scores vendor responses against weighted criteria and produces a panel-approved recommendation.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: vendor-rfp-evaluation-matrix
  title: Vendor and RFP evaluation matrix
  description: Independently scores vendor responses against weighted criteria and produces a panel-approved recommendation.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Select vendors through fair, traceable, and comparable evaluation.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 5
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - procurement-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: RFP responses and evaluation rubric
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - responses
          - rubric
          - weights
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: panel
      kind: agent
      name: Scoring panel
      role: Independent evaluator panel
      prompt: Score assigned vendor responses against every criterion. Cite proposal evidence and disclose conflicts.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: aggregate
      name: Aggregate panel scores
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Panel scoring analyst
      prompt: Apply the declared weights to panel scores, preserve evaluator-level evidence and conflicts, and report
        dispersion and outliers without forcing consensus.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: outlier-review
      kind: agent
      name: Review scoring outliers
      role: Procurement chair
      prompt: Review material score dispersion without forcing consensus. Record justified adjustments and unresolved dissent.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: recommendation
      name: Rank vendors and summarize
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Procurement recommendation analyst
      prompt: Rank vendors from the reconciled weighted scores and summarize delivery, commercial, compliance, and
        concentration risks with traceable evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: procurement-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Procurement authority approves recommendation
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Vendor evaluation matrix and award recommendation
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: panel
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: panel
      to: aggregate
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: aggregate
      to: outlier-review
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: outlier-review
      to: recommendation
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: aggregate
      to: recommendation
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: recommendation
      to: procurement-approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e7
      from: procurement-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
